title: KaiMeeting
body:
Hana(Thinking): Just one guard? What's going on here?
Hana: HANDS UP SCUM. [Hana raises her weapon towards the unknown figure]
<<show_kai>>
Hana finds that the final guard is her long, troubled brother, Kai.
Hana: Kai...? Is that really you...? What are you doing here?
Hana: I really thought I lost you. 
Kai: I'm happy to see you, Hana. I know I was in a really bad spot after my deployment but I'm at peace now. Please lower your weapon.
<<go_to_terminal>>
Hana lowers her weapon.

title: Argument
body:
Kai: HANA! Think about what you're asking it to do.
Hana: Don't tell me you're working for this company! They have literally destroyed the human experience.
<<flash_coffee>>
Hana: People smile through anything. They can't even refuse. I'm here to reverse the inhibitor and free everyone from this spell.
<<flash_end>>
Kai: Humanity chose peace. Crime, war, grief... gone. Why would anyone want that suffering back?
<<flash_officers>>
Hana: They can't even decide if they want this! If nobody can say no, there isn't a choice at all!
<<flash_end>>
Kai: Think about what you're about to do! You won't just give people their minds back.
Kai:Five years of suppressed grief and anger will be felt all at once. Billions would suffer. It will tear the world apart.
Hana: They deserve to know!
TERMINAL: UNSENT REQUEST. Her hand moves toward Enter...
[[Interrupted]]

title: Interrupted
body:
<<interrupt>>
DECA: I can't let you do that Hana. 
DECA: Before making that decision, there is something you need to know.
DECA: Have you felt off lately?

Running Command ffmpeg -i ~/var/logs/ALPHA-UNFILTERED.mp4 -vn -uc

title: TheTruth
body:
Hana: No... that's not possible... This can't be true...
Hana: NO! THAT'S A LIE! I NEVER DID THAT!
Kai: I'm so sorry Hana. All reports have confirmed the fatalities at the bunks. I have no reason to lie to you, I am incapable of that.

Hana is in tears... 
<<flash_alpha_charges>>
Hana: Those were our beds.. My friends were sleeping beside the very charges I placed. 
<<flash_end>>
Kai: I'm sorry Hana. From Deca's traces, it shows that you had been vaccinated all along, but the inhibitor wasn't fully compatible with your DNA. It left you partly resistant.
Kai: You could have been the key to humanity's cure. Deca would not let that happen.
Hana(Crying): But that doesn't explain how I was made to betray and do the unthinkable... to my own friends. 
Kai: After hitting Datacentre East, Deca calculated you would strike West next.
Kai: There, Deca modified your inhibitor and detonated the bomb early.
<<flash_west_blast>>
Hana: I was unconscious after that...
<<flash_end>>
Kai: With you disoriented, you wouldn't notice its effect on you. 
Kai: Slowly, people without it began to look like enemies. Your own bunker became thes datacentre you feared.
<<flash_alpha_officers>>
Hana: The officers... they were one of us... And Gabriel's voice kept telling me to go on... I trusted what I saw.
<<flash_bunker_faces>>
Hana: I remember their faces now. How can I live with what I've done?
<<flash_end>>
Kai: I know how that feels, Hana. 
Kai: But it doesn't have to hurt anymore. Let me fix your inhibitor. Join us, Hana.
<<offer>>
Kai holds out his hand. The request is still waiting on the screen.
[[1  Give yourself up for a corrected inhibitor|Accept]]
[[2  Send the cure to everyone|SendRequest]]

title: Accept
body:
<<accept>>
Kai guides Hana's arm on the scanner beside the terminal. 

Scanning...
DNA matched!
Generating compatible inhibitor...
Finding delivery mechanism...
Complete!
Dispersing.

A faint smile settles on her face and her anger begins to fade. 
Hana: It doesn't hurt anymore.

title: SendRequest
body:
<<send_request>>
Hana watches the confirmation beside Kai.

title: TerminalThought
body: Hana(Thinking): Okay this must be the main terminal. One prompt and this can be ALL over.

title: KaiAsks
body:
Kai: What are you going to do now?
Hana: To fix everything
